name: dialog
title: Dialog
summary: A window over the page for a form, details or settings.
description: A window that holds any content (a form, details, settings) and closes on Escape, a click outside or its close button. It sits over a dimmed page. Focus is trapped inside and returns to the trigger; the page behind is inert and does not scroll. To confirm a consequential action (delete, discard, revoke), use Alert dialog, which is this window with role="alertdialog". Behaviour comes from the Zag dialog machine, through Ark UI in React, Vue and Svelte.

anatomy.description: Layout-neutral hook around the trigger (display: contents)
aria-haspopup=dialog, aria-expanded, data-state=open|closed. The default trigger is a Button. Marked data-dialog="trigger".
Dims the page with color.scrim; rendered in a portal; data-state=open|closed. Stacks at --fndn-z-dialog (base.css).
Centres the window, or pins it near the top (placement=top); rendered in a portal

A Button: ghost, size sm, square, shape rounded, muted, aria-label=Close, with a tooltip of the same text. Only its placement (negative margins into the header corner) is the dialog's. Marked data-dialog="close".

open.description: data-state=open|closed on trigger, backdrop and content.

role.description: alertdialog for destructive confirms: a click outside does not close it and focus starts on the first action.

actions.description: Footer buttons in order, least destructive first. Each closes the dialog unless close is false. For a dialog that holds a form: an action with form="<id>" (the id of a form in the body) is rendered type="submit" form="<id>", so the browser checks the form (required, pattern) and Enter in one of its fields submits it. Its click does nothing else: the form's submit event, which the browser fires only for a valid form, calls onAction and closes the dialog unless close is false. A refused form leaves the dialog open with the browser's message. The form's own submit handler prevents the default, as any form's in an app does. An action without form is a plain button.

closable.description: Show the close button in the header.

bare.description: Bare: the dialog is only the frame (position, focus trap, motion). No fill, no shadow, no padding, no header; the title still names it for assistive technology. Its one child is the surface, as in a command palette.

size.description: Width of the window: sm 360px, md 440px, lg 880px (a large preview, such as agent-screen's viewer).

placement.description: Where the window sits: center (on a phone with a coarse pointer, at the bottom near the thumb), or top: pinned below the top of the viewport (min(15vh, 120px)) and growing downward, for a window whose height changes while it is used, such as a command palette whose results follow what is typed. A top window scales from its top edge.

instant.description: Opens and closes at once from the pointer too (from the keyboard it always does): no fade or scale of the window and the backdrop. For a window summoned many times a session, such as a command palette.

initialFocus.description: What takes focus when the dialog opens, in one of three forms: an element (a ref's current element); a CSS selector string, looked up inside the window first, then in the document ("#invite-email"); or a function returning the element, called when the dialog opens (the element may not exist before). Default: the first control; for alertdialog the first action. Ark's initialFocusEl.

triggerLabel.description: Renders a default Button trigger with this label. Otherwise pass your own trigger, or control `open` yourself.

slots.trigger: Your own trigger element (React `trigger` prop, Vue `trigger` slot, Svelte `trigger` snippet that spreads the props it receives)

events.action: (value: string) when a footer action is pressed; for an action with form, when its form is submitted

keyboard: Enter / Space on the trigger open
Focus moves into the window: the first focusable control, or the first action of an alertdialog
Tab and Shift+Tab cycle inside the window; focus cannot leave it
Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger
Enter in a field of a form an action names submits it, as that action's button would
A click on the dimmed page closes a dialog, not an alertdialog; either way it never moves focus out of the window
notes: Labelled by its title and described by its description.
While open, the rest of the page is inert and does not scroll.
Opening and closing from the keyboard are instant.

motion: window: opacity + scale from motion.popup-scale around its centre (its top edge when placement is top), duration.slow, easing.out-strong; closes at duration.fast
close button: the button's own hover and press (ghost Button)
instant: no motion at all; the window and the backdrop appear and leave in one frame
mounted open (defaultOpen, or open at mount): window and backdrop are drawn at once, with no entrance (data-mounted-open until it first closes); its close, and every later open, animate as above
